title: Joining the first two fields
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a type, let $u,v$ be finite lists of elements of $\Gamma$, and let $fs$ be a finite list of such lists. Joining the fields in $u::v::fs$ gives the list obtained by mapping $u$ to optional elements, then appending a blank separator and the joined fields in $v::fs$.
hypotheses_covered: $fs$ is a finite list of finite lists over $\Gamma$
